SELECT M.* FROM( SELECT 'PRJ_CHANCE' AS document_category, pc.chance_id AS document_id, pc.chance_number AS document_code, '商机' document_name, '商机' AS document_type_desc FROM prj_chance pc WHERE pc.CREATED_BY = #{authoritySourceId} OR #{authoritySourceId} IN ( SELECT SUA2.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua2 INNER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns fea2 ON sua2.employee_assign_id = FEA2.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID INNER JOIN fnd_org_position fop2 ON fea2.position_id = fop2.position_id WHERE fop2.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fop2.unit_id in ( SELECT unit_id FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea3 INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua3 ON fea3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = SUA3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID WHERE SUA3.user_id = pc.CREATED_BY ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'HLS_BP_MASTER' AS document_category, bm.bp_id AS document_id, bm.bp_code AS document_code, bm.BP_NAME AS document_name, (SELECT wm_concat(bt.description) from HLS_BP_MASTER_ROLE bmr INNER JOIN HLS_BP_TYPE bt ON bmr.bp_type = bt.bp_type WHERE bm.bp_id=bmr.bp_id AND bmr.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) AS document_type_desc FROM hls_bp_master bm WHERE bm.CREATED_BY = #{authoritySourceId} or #{authoritySourceId} in ( SELECT SUA2.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua2 INNER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns fea2 ON sua2.employee_assign_id = FEA2.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID INNER JOIN fnd_org_position fop2 ON fea2.position_id = fop2.position_id WHERE fop2.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fop2.unit_id in ( SELECT unit_id FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea3 INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua3 ON fea3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = SUA3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID WHERE SUA3.user_id = bm.CREATED_BY ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'CON_CONTRACT' AS document_category, contract_id AS document_id, contract_number AS document_code, CONTRACT_NAME AS document_name, '合同' AS document_type_desc FROM CON_CONTRACT WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID IN ( SELECT fea.employee_id FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea INNER JOIN sys_user_allocation sua ON fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id WHERE sua.user_id = #{authoritySourceId} or #{authoritySourceId} in ( SELECT SUA2.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua2 INNER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns fea2 ON sua2.employee_assign_id = FEA2.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID INNER JOIN fnd_org_position fop2 ON fea2.position_id = fop2.position_id WHERE fop2.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fop2.unit_id in ( SELECT unit_id FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea3 INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua3 ON fea3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = SUA3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID WHERE SUA3.user_id = sua.user_id ) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'PRJ_PROJECT' AS document_category, project_id AS document_id, project_number AS document_code, project_name AS document_name, '项目' AS document_type_desc FROM PRJ_PROJECT WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID IN ( SELECT fea.employee_id FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea INNER JOIN sys_user_allocation sua ON fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id WHERE sua.user_id = #{authoritySourceId} or #{authoritySourceId} in ( SELECT SUA2.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua2 INNER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns fea2 ON sua2.employee_assign_id = FEA2.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID INNER JOIN fnd_org_position fop2 ON fea2.position_id = fop2.position_id WHERE fop2.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fop2.unit_id in ( SELECT unit_id FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea3 INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua3 ON fea3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = SUA3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID WHERE SUA3.user_id = sua.user_id ) ) ) union all select 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE' AS document_category, hcl.credit_line_id AS document_id, hcl.credit_line_number AS document_code, hcl.credit_line_name AS document_name, '综合授信' AS document_type_desc FROM hls_credit_line hcl where hcl.business_type='CREDIT_LINE' and hcl.CREATED_BY = #{authoritySourceId} or #{authoritySourceId} in ( SELECT SUA2.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua2 INNER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns fea2 ON sua2.employee_assign_id = FEA2.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID INNER JOIN fnd_org_position fop2 ON fea2.position_id = fop2.position_id WHERE fop2.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fop2.unit_id in ( SELECT unit_id FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea3 INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua3 ON fea3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = SUA3.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID WHERE SUA3.user_id = hcl.CREATED_BY ) ) ) M
AND M.document_category = #{documentCategory,jdbcType=VARCHAR,javaType=String}
AND M.document_id = #{documentId}
AND M.document_code like CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{documentCode}, '%'))
AND M.document_name LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{documentName}, '%'))
AND M.document_type_desc LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{documentTypeDesc}, '%'))
ORDER BY M.document_id DESC
SELECT * FROM sys_user_authority_trx WHERE DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = #{documentCategory} AND AUTHORITY_SOURCE_ID = #{authoritySourceId} AND DOCUMENT_ID IS NULL
